title: Reading broker submissions in minutes, not days.
summary: Turnaround about 3 days to about 3 minutes;.

spec.problem: Broker submissions for sabotage-and-terrorism renewals took about three days to turn around.
spec.changed: A model reads the submission and drafts a priced quote email. An underwriter reviews every quote before it is sent.
spec.systems: Google Cloud Gemini; Hiscox AI Labs; broker email.
spec.measured: Quote turnaround time; share of the book on the process; UK productivity on submissions.
spec.result: **Turnaround about 3 days to about 3 minutes;** roughly two-thirds of the book on the process; CFO cited a 40% UK productivity gain on submissions. Company-reported, 2024 to 2025.[^21]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
